components.text: The [color=yellow]Engineering Station[color] is a very important machine.
This station is used to build [ref=stellaris:rocket/rockets]rockets[ref]. [br] You can also use it to upgrade your rockets and help you explore more planets! [br] [br]

**Space Station Planner** : [br] Use the rocket planner to build space station plans. Select your space station, place a space station blueprint and then add the needed resources to build the station.
